headline: Earlier VeriCUA paper reports learned GUI verification and reward gains
summary: A distinct Oct 19 arXiv paper, 2610.26469, introduces a learned GUI reward verifier also named VeriCUA; its authors and method differ from a later Oct 29 paper using the same acronym (arXiv:2610.40578). The earlier work trains a Judge to select checks and decide when to stop while a frozen Probe inspects live GUI state. The authors report higher agreement than prompted and passive verifiers across OSWorld, MobileWorld and WebArena-Verified, and a bounded downstream Actor-RL gain. Code and configuration details are publicly linked, but no independent reproduction was performed. The reported token comparison counts Probe use, not the full Judge, training or infrastructure cost.
